title: Your Files Don't Need to Leave Your Computer to Get Converted
description: Most online converters upload your files to remote servers. FileTools runs the conversion right in your browser. Here's why that matters.
excerpt: File conversion doesn't have to mean handing your documents to a stranger's server.
content:
Every time you upload a file to an online converter, you're trusting a server you know nothing about. Who runs it? Where's it hosted? How long do they keep your data? Most people never ask.

## The upload problem

Traditional conversion tools work like this: you send your file to their server, they process it, you download the result. Simple enough. But your file now exists on infrastructure you don't control.

For a vacation photo, maybe that's fine. For a contract, medical record, or financial statement? That's a different conversation.

## How [FileTools](https://filetools.eu) handles it

[FileTools](https://filetools.eu) processes files directly in your browser. The conversion happens on your machine. Your documents, images, and PDFs never travel to a remote server.

This isn't a marketing gimmick. Open your browser's network tab while converting. You'll see — nothing leaves.

## Who should care

Anyone handling sensitive documents. Lawyers converting case files to PDF. Accountants reformatting spreadsheets. HR departments processing employee records. Freelancers working under NDA.

If your work involves confidentiality — and most work does — where your files get processed matters.

## Still a full converter

Privacy doesn't mean limited. [FileTools](https://filetools.eu) handles PDF, DOCX, images, WEBP, SVG, and dozens of other formats. Batch conversion works too. No account needed, no software to install.

Compare that to tools like [TubeVoice](https://tubevoice.io) for video dubbing or [RoomFlip](https://roomflip.io) for interior design — each solves a specific problem cleanly. FileTools does the same for file conversion, minus the privacy tradeoff.

## The simple test

Next time you need to convert something sensitive, ask yourself: does this file need to leave my computer? With [FileTools](https://filetools.eu), the answer is no.
